parts.when: Any phase, after a **HAEMONCULUS** model of yours is **destroyed**.
parts.effect: Pay 1-3 [Pain tokens](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after a **HAEMONCULUS** model of yours is **destroyed**.

**Target:** That **HAEMONCULUS** model, despite its destruction.

**Effect:** Pay 1-3 [Pain tokens](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). As the phase ends, put the model back, **unengaged**, on the battlefield, as near as it can be to the spot where it was **destroyed**. It does not belong to any **attached** unit, its unit's **starting strength** is 1, and it has 1 wound left for each Pain token you paid.

**Restrictions:** This Stratagem cannot be used while your Pain token pool holds 0 tokens, and no **HAEMONCULUS** model can be its target a second time in the battle.
